description: Use ONLY when an A2UI-capable host or the user explicitly requests A2UI. Returns self-contained A2UI v0.9.1 Basic Catalog messages as application/a2ui+json embedded resource, plus text links. Requires a renderer supporting this catalog and openUrl. For normal gallery requests use get_realizations (MCP Apps). Same public realization search, optional location, no writes.

initial_state.description: Optional initial condition, supported by quoted project evidence.

object_type.description: Strict structured object-type filter; projects with unknown object type are omitted.

scope.description: Scope/feature phrase matched against structured scope, quoted completed work or public tags.

service.description: Optional service id or phrase, e.g. remont_lazienki, glazura, antresole_stropy.

name: get_realizations_a2ui
